items.title: 68089_John Malachi oral history interview
items.q: So later, after Charlie leaves the band and John Jackson came in the band, he was doing fine, you know.

ctx.x: One of the things that I remember about this genius of Charlie Parker was.... Back to the time when we first rehearsed the band in New York, at our very first rehearsal, these arrangements we played, the eight arrangements that we played... And they had a good sound and everything, and the band was sounding good.

So later, after Charlie leaves the band and John Jackson came in the band, he was doing fine, you know. As any new member in the band, everybody would compliment them and try to give them little hints about things that were happening. So every night, when we would finish playing, someone would say to John Jackson something to the effect of, 'Hey man, you sure sounded great tonight.
